auditor.role: independent i18n auditor: lopdev team `task` subagent job 65a7f97cab63 (manager session f52727670001, 'UI-2 i18n audit r1'); not the translator (lopdev coder job aceade24b830, 'UI-2 robustness + instrumentation', anthropic/claude-opus-5-5)
auditor.independence: A separate subagent instance from the translator job; same served model anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 (disclosed; per this session's harness system prompt, no fallback). Judged from the English, its context sidecar, the core glossary and the locale style guide, and shipped catalogue precedent; no MT used. Auditor-authored fixes are listed as findings with before/after.

findings.note: Mechanical pass on the audited bytes (auditor script, intl ICU parser from the worktree's node_modules): key set and order equal English (19); ICU parse OK; argument names/types equal English per key ({seconds} in detail_starting and reason.timed_out only); no bidi control characters (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C); no ASCII '...'; Local Operator and Windows kept Latin wherever English has them.
Terms checked: 重启服务器 (update_notification.restart_the_server), 复制诊断信息 (providers.phone), 电脑, 支持团队 (error_boundary), 显示详情; impersonal phrasing avoids 你/您 consistently.

T10 (English source/context, not these target bytes): {seconds} is a plain string argument with no plural arm and the context sidecar does not say its value. Today it is always 30 (READINESS_BUDGET_MS = 30_000 in src/main/backend/backend-service.ts), for which every locale's noun form is correct; a future budget like 21/22 s would need a plural select in ru (and en). Recorded as an English-side NIT on the PR; not counted against this locale.

findings.key: ui.common.backend_startup.title_starting, detail_starting, title_failed, reason.port_forbidden, reason.executable_blocked, reason.executable_missing, reason.timed_out

findings.after: 正在启动Local Operator服务器…… / 最多可能需要{seconds}秒 / Windows保留了 …
findings.note: zh-CN style guide: no space inserted between Chinese text and Latin/digit runs; shipped zh-CN copy follows it in 2129 strings vs 142 that space. Fixed by the auditor in 7 keys; locale-only.
zh-CN style guide: ellipsis is …… (two marks); the shipped sibling ui.chat.directory.pending_restarting reads 正在重启此会话的运行时……. Fixed by the auditor; locale-only.

findings.before: 有原因导致服务器无法启动。
findings.after: 某些原因导致服务器无法启动。
findings.note: 有原因导致 reads as a bare 'there is a reason that caused'; 某些原因导致 is the idiomatic vague-cause phrasing for English 'Something stopped…'. Fixed by the auditor; locale-only.
